easy.def: A note asking you to come to something.
examples: I got an invitation to a party.
The invitation says to come at two.
She wrote the invitation.

more.def: A message that asks someone to come to a party or event.
examples: I got an invitation to her birthday party.
The invitation said to come at two o'clock.
He made an invitation with paper and markers.
I will invite my friends to my party.
Our teacher invited a vet to class.
Invite your sister to play.

more.def: To ask someone to come somewhere or to do something with you.
examples: We invited our new neighbors over for dinner.
The neighbors invited us to their barbecue.
She was invited to speak at the meeting.

easy.def: To have something as a part.
examples: The game involves running.
Baking involves measuring.
This job involves lots of walking.

more.def: To include something as a necessary part.
examples: Playing the piano involves a lot of practice.
The project involves building a model volcano.
Camping involves sleeping in a tent.
Her involvement helped.
I thank you for your involvement.
The club needs involvement.

more.def: The act of taking part in something.
examples: Her involvement made the project a success.
Parents' involvement helps the school.
The club needs everyone's involvement.
